findings.claim: FY2024 10-K 風險因子：部分原料與服務依賴有限來源或單一來源供應商（如海綿鈦、特殊合金），且因認證要求替代來源不易取得
findings.excerpt: For certain raw materials and services, we depend on a number of limited source or sole source suppliers, such as for titanium sponge and specialized metal alloys.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：在歐洲、墨西哥、中國、日本等多國有營運；風險因子列示關稅、制裁、徵收、戰爭（含烏克蘭、中東）可能衝擊業務
findings.excerpt: Howmet Aerospace has operations or activities in numerous countries and regions outside the United States, including Europe, Mexico, China, and Japan.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：多數供應以年度或長約採購，其餘靠現貨；原料可得性可能受出口國政治不穩影響
findings.excerpt: We maintain annual or long-term contracts for a majority of our supply requirements, and, for the remainder, we depend on spot purchases.

geo_supply_chain.note: as_of 為依 10-K 一般申報時點的估計日期，非頁面確認；僅 2 次搜尋，未取得各廠址清單與具體單點資訊；FY2025 是否仍保留單一來源/海綿鈦字句未驗證。
